What Happens If You Lose a Finger? Can doctors reattach it? What should you do immediately after such an injury? Join Dr. Binocs as he explains the science behind severed fingers, first aid, surgery, and how the human body begins to heal. Learn these amazing medical facts in a fun and easy way that's perfect for curious kids and families. Don't miss this exciting and educational episode!
Make sure you watch the whole video to know all the answers to your curious questions!
